_about: Every product feature named in the old site, the staging build, the website quote and the Enterprise Module scope. Each must appear on at least one page: run `python3 scripts/check-features.py`. Source codes: OLD = zeenovo.com, STG = staging build, ENT = Enterprise Module proposal, DES = approved design, PDF = ZeeNovo website content (Nov 2026), DUMMY = placeholder.

adaptiveAssessment.title: Adaptive assessments
adaptiveAssessment.text: Questions change with the patient's sex and each answer, and the next relevant question is suggested automatically.

provinceLogic.title: Province-specific logic
provinceLogic.text: Each assessment follows the scope, conditions and terminology of the province the pharmacist practises in.

redFlags.title: Smart red flags
redFlags.text: Red flags are raised automatically from the answers given, with referral criteria shown where the decision is made.

healthFlags.title: Patient health flags
healthFlags.text: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, allergies, immunocompromised status and existing diagnoses are flagged on the record.

preVisitQuestionnaire.title: Pre-visit questionnaire
preVisitQuestionnaire.text: Patients answer intake questions before the visit, so the consultation starts with their history already captured.

guidedTreatment.title: Guided treatment paths
guidedTreatment.text: Treatment and self-care options are laid out by condition. The pharmacist confirms or changes every step.

conditionLibrary.title: 28 minor ailment conditions
conditionLibrary.text: Skin, infection, digestive, pain, respiratory, women's health and oral conditions, shown according to your province's list.

medicineSig.title: Saved directions by condition
medicineSig.text: Pick the medicine and directions from your pharmacy's saved presets. You confirm or change every step.

multiSig.title: Multiple SIGs per platform
multiSig.text: Directions are formatted for the prescribing platform your pharmacy uses.

customDrug.title: Custom drug selection
customDrug.text: Choose any medicine and directions when your saved presets don't fit the patient.

selfCare.title: Self-care suggestions
selfCare.text: Self-care advice for the condition appears beside the treatment options and is included in the record.

rxRequests.title: Prescription requests
rxRequests.text: New, refill, renewal and transfer requests from your website and the Patient Portal arrive in one queue, each with a clear status.

calendar.title: Customizable calendar
calendar.text: Time slots by pharmacist and by service, with time blocks and multi-staff scheduling.

walkIn.title: Walk-in intake
walkIn.text: Staff see a walk-in now or book the patient for a later time, on the same calendar as online bookings.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.text: Patients join a waitlist when a service is full, and get a link to book.

groupBooking.title: Group booking
groupBooking.text: Book a family or a clinic group in one appointment, with a separate record for each person.

holidays.title: Holiday management
holidays.text: Block dates once and every service and team calendar updates.

bulkServices.title: Bulk service control
bulkServices.text: Enable, disable or waitlist several services at once.

serviceLinks.title: Per-service booking links
serviceLinks.text: Every service has its own booking link to share on social media, by email or in ads.

bookingSource.title: Booking source tracking
bookingSource.text: Each appointment records where it came from: website, portal, voice, walk-in, staff, referral or campaign link.

csvImport.title: CSV patient import
csvImport.text: Import your patient list from a CSV export of your pharmacy management system. Booking finds the patient instantly.

autoFollowup.title: Automated follow-ups
autoFollowup.text: Patients receive follow-up questions by email, through a secure link. Only flagged responses go to a pharmacist for review.

followupTracking.title: Follow-up tracking and outcomes
followupTracking.text: See follow-up status and record the outcome as resolved, improved, unchanged or worse, on the original visit.

followupScheduling.title: Follow-up scheduling
followupScheduling.text: Schedule the next check at the end of a visit, with a clear date for the team.

doseReminders.title: Dose reminders
doseReminders.text: Second doses, boosters and injection series are reminded by email when the next dose is due.

familyDoctor.title: Family physician lookup
familyDoctor.text: The patient's family physician is found within the flow, saved, and reused at every visit and fax.

prm.title: Patient relationship management
prm.text: Visit history, communication and follow-ups stay with the patient for continuity of care.

autofillPrefs.title: Autofill preferences
autofillPrefs.text: Saved inputs fill repeat fields, so assessments move faster.

autoDocs.title: Automated documentation
autoDocs.text: Every assessment generates its PDF documentation as the consultation happens.

efax.title: Built-in eFax
efax.text: Fax the physician from the visit without leaving ZeeNovo, with a log of what was sent, when, and its status.

storage.title: Stored in Canada
storage.text: Patient records are stored in Canada, with role-based access.

vaccinePrograms.title: COVID-19, flu and other vaccines
vaccinePrograms.text: Publicly funded flu and COVID-19, other routine and travel vaccines, and medicine injections, each with its own booking and record.

vaccineAutofill.title: Saved vaccine preferences
vaccineAutofill.text: Choose this season's vaccines and lots once. Vaccine, lot, expiry, route and site fill in on every visit.

quickVaccineFlow.title: Quick Complete
quickVaccineFlow.text: For publicly funded flu and COVID-19, the visit goes from screening to documented administration in a few clicks.

injections.title: Injection management
injections.text: Medicine injections booked as a service, with dose series and rebooking links.

medicationReview.title: MedsCheck reviews
medicationReview.text: Ontario MedsCheck reviews with Kroll medication history PDF import and the MedsCheck forms filled in. Early access.

poct.title: Point-of-care testing
poct.text: Blood glucose, blood pressure, haemoglobin and COVID-19 results recorded on the visit, with a physician report to fax. Early access.

vaccineEditVisit.title: Edit a single visit
vaccineEditVisit.text: Change one visit's vaccine details without changing your saved preferences.

reminderBookingLink.title: Booking link in every reminder
reminderBookingLink.text: Patients book the next dose straight from the reminder email.

doseElsewhere.title: Dose given elsewhere
doseElsewhere.text: Patients can tell the pharmacy they've already had the dose somewhere else.

reminderHistory.title: Reminder history
reminderHistory.text: Every reminder sent is kept on the patient's record.

readyForPharmacist.title: Ready for the pharmacist
readyForPharmacist.text: Staff complete intake and mark the visit ready for the pharmacist.

poctDevices.title: Device registry
poctDevices.text: Register your testing devices, with result fields your pharmacy sets up.

poctWorkflows.title: Standard and diabetes-enhanced workflows
poctWorkflows.text: A standard testing workflow, and an enhanced one for patients with diabetes.

poctPhysicianReport.title: Physician report by fax
poctPhysicianReport.text: A physician report from the test result, faxed from the same record.

poctPatientReport.title: Patient report by email
poctPatientReport.text: The patient receives a report of the result by email.

unlimitedUsers.title: Unlimited users
unlimitedUsers.text: Every team member has their own login and role, with no per-seat fees.

quickSetup.title: Set up in a day
quickSetup.text: Import patients, choose services and start booking, usually within one day.

billingPins.title: Billing PIN on every visit
billingPins.text: The billing PIN for the service, province, visit mode and outcome is shown on every visit. Fewer lookups. Fewer claim errors.

incidentCapture.title: Near-miss reporting
incidentCapture.text: Near misses get the same structured record as incidents.

guidedReporting.title: Guided reporting
guidedReporting.text: Guided fields for severity, process stage, discovery, contributing factors, patient and medication details.

nidr.title: National reporting to ISMP Canada
nidr.text: Incident data is submitted to ISMP Canada's National Incident Data Repository.

deidentify.title: De-identification
deidentify.text: Patient and staff details are protected, so the team can report and learn safely.

rca.title: Root cause analysis
rca.text: A guided 5 Whys finds where in the process the gap occurred.

contributingFactors.title: Contributing factors
contributingFactors.text: Human, system and environmental contributing factors, chosen from a structured list.

caseManagement.title: Case management
caseManagement.text: Review, assign, filter and close cases, with notes and a status on every one.

actionPlans.title: Action plans and reminders
actionPlans.text: Every analysis becomes an action plan with owners, due dates and automatic reminders.

trendDashboards.title: Trend dashboards
trendDashboards.text: Incident trends by degree of harm, contributing factor, medication, process stage and discovery.

performanceView.title: Performance at a glance
performanceView.text: Follow-up success rate, pharmacy safety score and productivity on one view.

sop.title: SOP library and sign-off
sop.text: Assign the current version, record each acknowledgement and keep the version history.

cqi.title: CQI meetings
cqi.text: Attendees, minutes, linked incidents and follow-ups in one record.

correctiveActions.title: Corrective actions
correctiveActions.text: Every corrective action has an owner, a due date, a status and a completion date.

staffTraining.title: Staff competency assessments
staffTraining.text: Role-based assessments scored by module, with a risk level: 43 modules and 258 questions across four roles.

mssa.title: ISMP Canada MSSA
mssa.text: ISMP Canada's validated Medication Safety Self-Assessment. Ask how ZeeNovo supports it.

selfAssessment.title: Pharmacy self-assessment
selfAssessment.text: 63 questions across six safety domains, with a Pharmacy Safety Score, gaps by domain, an action plan and a PDF report.

userAccess.title: Individual logins
userAccess.text: Every team member has a login of their own.

learnings.title: Learnings recorded
learnings.text: The learning from each incident is recorded on the incident.

complianceDashboard.title: Compliance dashboard
complianceDashboard.text: Open incidents, SOP training and CQI follow-ups, shown as complete or overdue.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.text: Who caught each incident, and at which stage.

competencyRefresher.title: Refreshers from results
competencyRefresher.text: Assessment results point to the SOP or refresher to assign.

competencyReminders.title: Competency reminders
competencyReminders.text: Due-soon and overdue reminders for each assessment. Coming soon.

siteDesign.title: Seven themes
siteDesign.text: Your name, logo and colours on one of seven themes, at your ZeeNovo web address.

liveBooking.title: Live booking
liveBooking.text: Patients book online with screening questions, consent and a one-time code.

siteServiceControl.title: Service on/off control
siteServiceControl.text: Turn a service on or off on the website from your dashboard, instantly.

categoryPages.title: Category landing pages
categoryPages.text: Ready-made pages for vaccines, minor ailments and every other service category.

seo.title: Search-friendly
seo.text: Fast, structured pages built to be found by patients searching locally.

liveSync.title: Live sync with ZeeNovo
liveSync.text: The site stays in step with your ZeeNovo services and calendar.

siteIncluded.title: Included with every plan
siteIncluded.text: The website comes with every ZeeNovo plan.

conditionPages.title: A page for each minor ailment
conditionPages.text: Created when you turn the service on, with your pharmacy's name, town and booking link.

aboutDraft.title: About page drafted for you
aboutDraft.text: Drafted from your hours, location and services. You edit it before publishing. No patient information is used.

confirmations.title: Email and SMS confirmations
confirmations.text: Patients get a booking confirmation by email and SMS.

centralListing.title: Listed in ZeeNovo Central
centralListing.text: Your pharmacy appears in the ZeeNovo Central directory. Launching soon.

voiceBooking.title: Voice-based booking
voiceBooking.text: Patients book by speaking in plain language. ZeeNovo matches the request to a service and an open time.

manageAppointments.title: Manage appointments
manageAppointments.text: Patients view, reschedule or cancel their own appointments.

portalRx.title: Online prescription requests
portalRx.text: Patients request prescriptions and track their status without calling.

portalReminders.title: Follow-up questions
portalReminders.text: Patients answer follow-up questions through a secure link.

patientLogins.title: Secure sign-in
patientLogins.text: Each patient signs in with an email, a password and a one-time code.

portalDoseReplies.title: Next-dose booking
portalDoseReplies.text: Patients respond to dose reminders and book the next dose.

patientProfile.title: Profile and family physician
patientProfile.text: Patients keep their profile and family physician on file.

masterFormulas.title: Versioned master formulas
masterFormulas.text: A new version for every change. Past batches keep the version they used.

formulaApproval.title: Second-pharmacist approval
formulaApproval.text: Authors cannot approve their own formula.

budDates.title: Cited beyond-use date
budDates.text: A cited beyond-use date reference is required before a formula goes active.

formulaLibrary.title: Starter formula library
formulaLibrary.text: Adopt a starter formula and adapt it for your pharmacy.

batchScaling.title: Scales to any batch size
batchScaling.text: With overage for capsules and liquids.

concentrationUnits.title: Every common unit
concentrationUnits.text: q.s. and q.s. ad; % w/w, % w/v, % v/v, mg/mL, mg/g, ratio and mg per unit.

saltPotency.title: Salt and potency correction
saltPotency.text: Salt-to-base conversion, and potency correction from the certificate of analysis.

dosageForms.title: Capsules, suppositories and suspensions
dosageForms.text: Capsule count and filler weight, suppository base with displacement factors and mould calibration, and suspensions from crushed tablets.

minWeighable.title: Minimum weighable quantity
minWeighable.text: Every quantity is checked against it, with a suggested trituration.

unsafeInputs.title: Unsafe inputs refused
unsafeInputs.text: A negative q.s., a missing density, an unreferenced salt form or a drug that won't fit the mould.

riskAssessment.title: NAPRA risk assessment
riskAssessment.text: A guided decision tree to Level A, B or C. The pharmacist answers each question, and the path is saved with the formula.

batchRecords.title: Fixed batch stages
batchRecords.text: Materials, compounding, QC, verify and release, in that order. Voiding a batch needs a reason.

secondCheck.title: PIN e-signatures
secondCheck.text: Each signature is stored with the signer's role. A second person verifies and releases.

releaseChecks.title: Release checks
releaseChecks.text: Release is blocked until every QC check passes, every step is complete, a lot is assigned and the formula is cited.

competencyGates.title: Competency gates
competencyGates.text: Staff with lapsed competency cannot sign.

capaGates.title: CAPA gates
capaGates.text: A voided batch cannot be remade until its CAPA is closed.

postReleaseChanges.title: Post-release changes
postReleaseChanges.text: Changes after release need an owner or manager PIN and a reason.

ingredientList.title: Master ingredient list
ingredientList.text: Salt factor, density, controlled schedule and hazard fields for every ingredient.

ingredientDocs.title: Certificates and safety data sheets
ingredientDocs.text: Certificates of analysis and SDS stored for each ingredient.

purchasing.title: Vendors and purchasing
purchasing.text: Vendors, pack sizes, prices, purchase orders and receiving.

quarantine.title: Quarantine on receipt
quarantine.text: Expired stock and out-of-range potency are rejected.

lotBlocking.title: Unusable lots blocked
lotBlocking.text: Quarantined, expired or recalled lots cannot be selected.

lowStock.title: Low-stock flags
lowStock.text: Reorder points, with lots listed by earliest expiry.

ingredientVersions.title: Ingredient versions
ingredientVersions.text: Your pharmacy stays on its accepted version until a manager accepts an update. History is kept for past batches.

recallTrace.title: Lot-to-patient tracing
recallTrace.text: Recall a lot and see the affected batches, the patients and the number to contact.

recallClose.title: Contacts and returns logged
recallClose.text: Closing a recall needs a PIN, and only once every contact is logged.

qualityLogs.title: Temperature, cleaning and calibration logs
qualityLogs.text: Hazardous handling logs too. An out-of-range temperature raises a deviation automatically.

equipmentRegister.title: Equipment register
equipmentRegister.text: Calibration history for every device. Batches are blocked when the balance is out of calibration.

deviationsCapa.title: Deviations, CAPA and complaints
deviationsCapa.text: Each e-signed, with periodic log reviews. Complaints link to a deviation and CAPA.

controlledRegister.title: Controlled substance register
controlledRegister.text: Witnessed entries, reconciliation, and loss and theft reporting.

compoundPricing.title: Priced from the formula
compoundPricing.text: The price is calculated from the formula's ingredients and quantities.

compoundFees.title: Fees set once
compoundFees.text: Dispensing and compounding fees, including time-based fees.

consistentQuotes.title: Consistent quotes
consistentQuotes.text: Every pharmacist quotes the same preparation the same way.

chainDomain.title: Your domain
chainDomain.text: Start on a ZeeNovo subdomain, such as yourgroup.zeenovo.com, and point your own domain to it later.

chainPlatform.title: Your brand
chainPlatform.text: Group name, logo and colours across the platform.

serviceFirst.title: Service first
serviceFirst.text: Patients pick the service, then the pharmacy.

chainServiceFilter.title: Only pharmacies that offer it
chainServiceFilter.text: Pharmacies are listed by province and filtered by the chosen service.

chainCalendar.title: Booking in the pharmacy's own calendar
chainCalendar.text: Uses each pharmacy's existing ZeeNovo booking flow. Nothing changes for the store team.

central.title: ZeeNovo Central
central.text: Your pharmacies are listed in ZeeNovo's public directory, by location and service.

execSummary.title: Executive summary
execSummary.text: Eight headline figures: active pharmacies, module adoption, services completed, unique patients, estimated service value, and appointment, follow-up and confirmed positive outcome rates.

reportingParameters.title: Reporting measures
reportingParameters.text: Network status, adoption, participation, services, patients, utilization, value, appointments, booking origin, programs, follow-up and quality.

drillDowns.title: Program drill-downs
drillDowns.text: Minor ailments, flu and COVID-19, medication reviews, and follow-up and outcomes, each on its own view.

locationComparison.title: Location comparison
locationComparison.text: Member pharmacies compared on the same definitions and thresholds.

periodComparison.title: Period-over-period comparison
periodComparison.text: Every figure compares with the previous period and breaks down by location where privacy thresholds allow.

serviceValues.title: Estimated service value
serviceValues.text: Calculated from service values you set. Labelled as an estimate, not confirmed claims or payments.

networkQuality.title: Network quality analytics
networkQuality.text: Incident and CQI activity, SOP completion, staff assessment and training, self-assessment, and corrective action completion, by network and pharmacy.

methodology.title: Methodology page
methodology.text: Every calculation is documented, so a number means the same thing at network, province and pharmacy level.

methodExclusions.title: Excluded records listed
methodExclusions.text: Records left out of a figure are listed, not silently dropped.

methodResponses.title: Outcomes against valid responses
methodResponses.text: Response rate is shown beside outcome rate. Non-responders are never counted as successes.

minimumCohort.title: Minimum group size
minimumCohort.text: Results appear only above a privacy threshold. Below it, the dashboard shows "insufficient data".

suppression.title: Protected totals
suppression.text: A hidden figure can't be worked out from the totals around it.

privacyFilters.title: Protected filters and exports
privacyFilters.text: No filter or export combination can cut a group below the threshold.

privacyBroaderCuts.title: Broader cuts when needed
privacyBroaderCuts.text: Broad age bands, weekly or monthly periods and broader clinical categories replace narrower cuts.

noPatientData.title: No patient identifiers
noPatientData.text: No names, health card numbers, contact details, exact dates of birth, medication names, assessment answers or free-text notes. No patient-level drill-down, even when the location is known.

privacySameRules.title: Same rules everywhere
privacySameRules.text: Cards, charts, tables, comparisons, rankings and downloads follow the same privacy rules.

privacyContext.title: Full context on every percentage
privacyContext.text: Numerator, denominator and response rate are shown with every rate.

accessLogs.title: Logged access
accessLogs.text: Role-based access, with access and export logs.

communication.title: One inbox per pharmacy
communication.text: Group and ZeeNovo messages arrive in the same communication tab on the pharmacy dashboard.

targetedSends.title: Targeted sends
targetedSends.text: Send to the whole network, one province or one pharmacy.

messageAlerts.title: Categories and email nudges
messageAlerts.text: Messages are categorised, for example formulary updates and general updates. Email only flags that a message is waiting.

messageReceipts.title: Acknowledgement reports
messageReceipts.text: See which pharmacies have read each message.

onboarding.title: Member import
onboarding.text: Send your member list. ZeeNovo imports the locations and sends the invitations.

locationStatus.title: Location status
locationStatus.text: Invited, onboarding, activated, inactive or suspended. Activation is reported separately from clinical activity.

networkConfig.title: Configuration
networkConfig.text: Group name, logo, colours, domain and the service values used to estimate care delivered.

roles.title: Roles and capabilities
roles.text: Reporting is always on. Communication, network, user, brand and domain rights are granted per user.

primaryAdmin.title: One Primary Admin, always
primaryAdmin.text: Transferable to another active admin, never removed. Only the Primary Admin manages brand and domain or forces a lockout.

supportAccess.title: Separate support access
supportAccess.text: ZeeNovo support access is separate from enterprise roles and logged separately.

revenueView.title: Estimated revenue
revenueView.text: Estimated revenue for each completed visit, by service and by pharmacist, plus staff productivity and top services.

ownClaims.title: Your claims, your system
ownClaims.text: ZeeNovo doesn't submit claims to OHIP, ODB or any payer. You bill through your own pharmacy system.

staffSignIn.title: Sign-in check
staffSignIn.text: Staff sign in with a password plus a one-time code.

rolePermissions.title: Custom role permissions
rolePermissions.text: Coming soon. Adjust what each role can do, within scope of practice.

dutyPin.title: Duty PIN
dutyPin.text: Coming soon. The pharmacist on duty signs in to the shift with a PIN, so vaccines recorded by technicians carry the right pharmacist's name.
